thread:
maria: Quick async check-in — sampleflow quickstart is failing on macOS CI (M1). Short update in w/t/b format.

maria: What I did: pushed a tiny sample app fix and updated the README to include the new env var behavior. Opened a PR but CI is flaky. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleflow/pull/342
Blockers: CI on mac runners errors out with a brew/linker error, can't reproduce locally on Intel mac or linux. Not sure if it's the container or the script.
Today: trying to reproduce on an M1 runner and triage whether docs need wording change vs fix in start script.

alex: saw the CI failure — can you paste the error snippet?

maria: paste from the failing runner: ```
error: could not load library 'libomp.dylib'
ld: framework not found libomp
exit code: 1
```

sam: hmm, last time we had that it was missing a brew dependency in the mac image. PR to sampleflow might need a ci matrix tweak to `brew install libomp` before building.

ci-bot: [CI] sampleflow / macos-m1 / build #128 failed — see https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/sampleflow/128/logs

alex: @maria can you try a quick repro using the same docker image tag the CI uses? I can spare a runner for 30m if you want.

maria: thanks — will kick off a debug runner now with the same tag. If I can reproduce, I'll try adding `brew install libomp` to the mac job and re-run.

lin: I can take the docs side if this is a wording/quickstart issue. If the fix is to change the start script, I'll update the quickstart steps and note that M1 needs libomp explicitly. Will open a small PR for docs so customers aren't blocked.

sam: plan sounds good. If it's a CI image gap we should also add a short e2e note in the SDK quickstart about platform-specific deps (mac M1).

maria: update — I reproduced on an M1 debug runner, adding `brew install libomp` fixes the build. I'll push a CI job patch and link the PR.

maria: PR for CI matrix tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleflow/pull/343 — small change to mac job.

lin: I'll open docs PR referencing PR 343 and add a short troubleshooting section: "mac (M1) users may need to install libomp" with the one-liner.

lin: docs PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — will include the code snippet below in the quickstart.

lin: ```bash
# mac (M1) / homebrew
brew install libomp
```

alex: :thumbsup: nice catch. If CI passes after the tweak we can merge both and cut a patch release to sampleflow sample app.

ci-bot: [CI] sampleflow / macos-m1 / build #129 queued

maria: will monitor #129 and post final status here. If anything blocks, ping me. Thanks! :rocket:
